entries.subject: topic:tharavad_matrilineal_family
entries.value_text: Marumakkathayam was a system in Kerala in which descent and inheritance of property passed from the maternal uncle to nephews or nieces, and a tharavad refers to the extended family sharing the ancestral house.

sources.excerpt: Through this system, descent and the inheritance of property were passed from the maternal uncle to nephews or nieces.
